date_note: Abnormal access dated 11 Nov by MTN and 10 Nov by Dailysecu; the Federation's first notice was 14 Nov (the date used here); it confirmed the leak in an 18 Nov notice.
title: Korea Federation of SMEs confirms leak of over 360,000 Yellow Umbrella customer records
org: Korea Federation of Small and Medium Business (Kbiz)
impact: The Federation says over 360,000 records of customer personal and contract information leaked, including account numbers and payment details.
summary: Dailysecu reports the Federation of SMEs, in a notice of 18 November, confirmed a leak of over 360,000 customer personal and contract records from its Yellow Umbrella site after an external inspection. Exposed items include names, mobile numbers, addresses, business details, payment amounts and bank account numbers; the last seven digits of the ID number are said to be encrypted. It dated the abnormal access to 10 November; MTN gave 11 November.
plain: A Korean small-business mutual-aid scheme says over 360,000 customer records leaked, including names, addresses and bank account numbers.
exec: A large business body confirmed a leak of over 360,000 records with payment data, which fuels targeted fraud and phishing.
action: Members should ignore calls or texts asking for money, loans or account changes, not click links in unsolicited messages, and check which of their items leaked on the site's notice screen.

validation.note: MTN (14 Nov) and Dailysecu (19 Nov) both read; both relay the Federation's own notices. They differ on the access date (11 Nov MTN, 10 Nov Dailysecu).

review.note: Compared title, 360,000+ figure, data items, access dates (10 vs 11 Nov, noted), 18 Nov notice against Dailysecu and MTN
